items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (readPoint, maxEncodedClippedShapes, shapeIndexEncodingVersion) and exported Encode/Decode have doc comments. Single-letter receivers (l, p, d, e) follow Go convention and match the existing code. Formatting is gofmt-clean.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Encode/Decode were appended to shapeindex.go (~400 lines), not the dedicated shapeindex_encode.go the conventions ask for. The read-points loop with `min(int(n), 1024)` is copied across 5 decoders. New test file is far over 500 lines (1665 lines added in total).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Every length is bounded before allocating, and decode checks cell IDs, shape refs, edge IDs, NaN/Inf and bool bytes. Weaknesses: a catch-all recover hides real bugs, the 1024 literal is repeated, and nil shapes are detected with reflect.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Adds typeTagLoop=6 and typeTagLaxLoop=7 with no renumbering; Shape interface and wire formats unchanged. Existing decoders are now stricter: readBool rejects bytes other than 0/1, and readPoint rejects NaN/Inf in Loop/Polyline/Polygon. Polyline.decode's signature changed.
